title: InputPanel reads the plaintext mirror key at mount, including on a page that may not write this device's files
evidence: widget-src/src/components/InputPanel.tsx:198 called loadFromLocalStorage() (health_roadmap_data) once at mount to pick the legacy or matrix vitals view. On a page that may not write this device's health files (US-09 AC2c) the read still happened; it only picked the view, and nothing from it was shown. Found 2026-11-13. Closed by PR 1508 (merged as d565cfbd), which deleted vitalsViewMode and its read. Check on d565cfbd: grep for loadFromLocalStorage, health_roadmap_data and vitalsViewMode finds nothing in InputPanel.tsx or any component or hook it imports; the only non-test callers left are widget-src/src/hooks/useRecordReads.ts:37 (HealthTool's record read), lib/storage.ts and chatbot-embed.tsx:22, none in InputPanel.
